name: Voyge
tagline: Enterprise logistics for goods that can't be treated like freight.
positioning: Voyge is the supply-chain layer for makers shipping fragile, high-value, made-to-order goods at enterprise volume — with chain-of-custody, damage-aware routing, and per-unit care baked in.

hero.h1: Every handmade order deserves a supply chain built around it.
hero.sub: Voyge moves ceramics, small-batch spirits, bespoke furniture, and limited runs the way your makers would — tracked unit by unit, routed to avoid damage, and reconciled against every purchase order without the spreadsheet archaeology.

features.title: Unit-level chain of custody
features.description: Every piece gets a scan at each touch — from the maker's bench to the receiving dock. When a buyer asks where order #4471 is, you answer in seconds, not emails.

features.title: Damage-aware routing
features.description: Voyge models fragility, orientation, and handoff count per SKU, then routes around the lanes and carriers that historically break your goods. Fewer claims, fewer reships.

features.title: Small-batch consolidation
features.description: Group made-to-order runs from a dozen ateliers into a single audited shipment without losing per-maker provenance or splitting your invoices.

features.title: Returns handled as originals
features.description: Reverse logistics with the same care as the first mile — inspected, re-photographed, and restocked or routed to repair with a full condition record.

testimonials.quote: We shipped 9,000 hand-thrown pieces last quarter and our breakage claims dropped by two-thirds. The provenance record alone ended three years of arguing with our wholesale accounts.
testimonials.name: Marisol Ferreira

testimonials.quote: Before Voyge, consolidating twelve furniture makers into one B2B order was a week of phone calls. Now it's a routing plan I approve on Monday morning, invoiced per unit.
testimonials.name: Devin Ashworth

testimonials.quote: The unit-level scans mean our compliance team can audit a shipment of small-batch spirits end to end. Our distributors trust the paperwork now, which is most of the battle.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

homepage.footerBlurb: Voyge is the logistics layer for makers who refuse to treat their work like pallets. Built for enterprise buyers who need provenance, care, and a per-unit paper trail that holds up.
